task: Draft a product introduction email to prospective business customers for a fictional project-management tool. Include a subject line and a body organised into three short paragraphs covering: (1) core task-management features, (2) team visibility and integrations, (3) a closing with a demo link. Use only the supplied product facts. Do not add urgency, pricing, customer testimonials, or quantified performance claims.

facts.text: The fictional product is called TaskHaven.
TaskHaven allows teams to assign tasks to named owners and track status in a shared board.
Automated reminders are sent to task owners 24 hours before a due date.
Tasks can be tagged by project or priority to allow filtered views.
A weekly digest email summarises overdue items for each task owner.
TaskHaven integrates with Outlook and Gmail to allow tasks to be created directly from email messages.
A team dashboard shows completion-rate progress across all active projects.
A demo can be requested at https://example.org/taskhaven/demo; submitting the form does not create an account.
No pricing is included in the supplied facts.

forbidden_additions: A subscription price, free-trial offer, or expiring discount.
A customer success story, testimonial, or quantified productivity claim.
A claim that submitting the demo form immediately creates an account.
preserve: The task-assignment, shared-board, and tag-filtering features.
The 24-hour reminder and weekly digest features.
The Outlook and Gmail integration and the team dashboard.
The demo URL without implying immediate account creation.
